faq.question: Is this course suitable for complete beginners with no prior marketing experience?
faq.answer: Yes. AI Digital Marketing Specialist is designed specifically for beginners, college students, career switchers, and junior marketing executives. There are no prerequisites other than basic computer and internet literacy. All marketing fundamentals, advertising platforms, and technical concepts are taught step-by-step from scratch.

faq.question: What is the course duration and weekly schedule?
faq.answer: The course runs for 3 Months (12 teaching weeks), delivering exactly 120 guided hours of instructor-led training, live platform walkthroughs, and supervised practical labs (targeting 10 guided hours per week).

faq.question: How much independent practice is expected outside guided training?
faq.answer: We recommend 40 to 60 additional hours of independent practice over the 12 weeks (approximately 3 to 5 hours per week). This time is dedicated to self-paced tool navigation, creative variations, portfolio documentation, and project refinement.

faq.question: Which software tools and platforms will I learn to practical proficiency?
faq.answer: You will develop practical proficiency in core platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Canva, ChatGPT, and Google Gemini. You also gain working proficiency in supporting tools including Google Keyword Planner, Google Trends, Google Business Profile, WordPress, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Meta Business Suite, and Brevo, plus introductory exposure to Semrush, Microsoft Clarity, and Adobe Firefly.

faq.question: What practical projects will I build for my professional portfolio?
faq.answer: You will build 5 tangible portfolio projects: (1) an SEO Audit & Keyword Research Project, (2) a Social Media Content Campaign, (3) a Google & Meta Advertising Setup, (4) a Conversion Landing Page & Tracking Exercise, and (5) an Integrated Local Business Digital Marketing Capstone. These assets form an employer-ready portfolio demonstrating verified proof-of-work.

faq.question: How is AI integrated into the digital marketing curriculum?
faq.answer: AI is integrated as a practical productivity copilot across all modules. You learn structured prompt engineering in ChatGPT and Gemini for buyer persona research, copywriting variations (AIDA/PAS), search intent clustering, and email drafting. You also learn human verification protocols and ethical guidelines to ensure high-quality, commercially compliant marketing output.

faq.question: Do I need to spend my own money on ad budgets or paid software subscriptions?
faq.answer: No. Nova Skills strictly enforces a Zero-Student-Ad-Spend Policy. All paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager are built in authorized draft modes, sandbox accounts, or offline simulation workbooks. No personal credit cards or ad spending are required. Furthermore, all software used in student labs utilizes free tiers or educational sandboxes.

faq.question: What tools use demonstration properties or authorized simulations?
faq.answer: Google's public GA4 demo account is used for report exploration and traffic analysis, while editable event tagging and Google Tag Manager exercises are conducted on student WordPress sandbox sites. Advanced enterprise SEO tools (Semrush/Ahrefs) are demonstrated via instructor walkthroughs and free exploratory features, ensuring you understand their commercial value without paying $130+/month subscriptions.

faq.question: How are students evaluated for certification?
faq.answer: Certification is evaluated based on practical project deliverables (50%), the integrated capstone portfolio (20%), a timed technical troubleshooting examination (15%), and an oral viva voce defense (15%). Completing these requirements with passing grades awards the Certified AI Digital Marketing Specialist credential.

faq.question: What placement support is provided after graduation?
faq.answer: Students receive dedicated placement assistance, including portfolio reviews, resume optimization for entry-level digital marketing roles, LinkedIn profile enhancement, and interview preparation drills. While we provide active placement support and connect graduates with hiring opportunities, Nova Skills does not make false promises of guaranteed jobs or immediate freelancing wealth.

faq.question: What job roles can I apply for after completing this program?
faq.answer: Graduates are prepared for entry-level digital marketing roles such as Digital Marketing Executive, Junior SEO Executive, Social Media Marketing Executive, Junior Paid Ads Executive, and Digital Marketing Assistant. The curriculum focuses on foundational execution rather than senior management or full-funnel corporate strategy.

lessons.why_it_matters: Short-form vertical video is the dominant organic growth engine across social platforms in 2026/27.
lessons.what_learner_does: Script and storyboard 4 short-video concepts, producing and editing at least 1 completed 30-second mobile reel with captions and hooks.
lessons.expected_outcome: Four Short-Form Video Concepts & One Fully Edited Mobile Reel.

modules.hands_on_practice: Develop a 14-day content calendar, design eight social creatives, and produce four short-video concepts or completed edited reels.
modules.assignment: Student Deliverable 3: Multi-Channel Social Media Campaign Portfolio (14-day calendar, 8 polished Canva creatives, and 4 short-form video scripts/reels).
modules.business_application: Prepares graduates to take immediate ownership of social media accounts, organic content production, and AI-assisted creative workflows.
modules.expected_outcome: Complete commercial social media creative portfolio asset demonstrating copywriting, visual design, and video competence.

modules.module_purpose: Master the mechanics, architectures, bidding strategies, policy constraints, and execution of paid search (Google Ads) and paid social (Meta Ads) advertising without risking personal student capital.
what_you_will_learn: Understand paid advertising auction economics, Ad Rank, Quality Score, and commercial KPI calculations.
Build Google Search campaign architectures with proper ad groups, keyword match types, and negative lists.
Write high-relevance Responsive Search Ads (RSAs) and configure ad assets (sitelinks, callouts).
Analyze search term reports and grasp introductory Performance Max (PMax) and AI Max for Search.
Structure Meta Ads Manager campaigns using ODAX objectives, ad sets, placements, and audience targeting.
Create native Meta instant lead generation forms and apply platform advertising compliance policies.

lessons.lesson_title: Paid Advertising Ecosystem, Auction Economics & Account Governance
lessons.what_is_taught: The paid media landscape, search intent vs. interruption social advertising, auction bidding mechanics, and account governance.
subtopics: Paid advertising ecosystem: Pull marketing (Google Search intent) vs. Push marketing (Meta feed discovery)
Auction models and Ad Rank mechanics: Max CPC bid x Quality Score + Expected Impact of Assets
Deconstructing Quality Score: Expected CTR, Ad Relevance, and Landing Page Experience
Core economic KPI calculations: CPM, CPC, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA, and ROAS
Account governance: Google Ads MCC vs. Individual Accounts; Meta Business Portfolio / Manager vs. Personal Ad Accounts
lessons.why_it_matters: Understanding auction math prevents marketers from overbidding on low-intent terms or delivering poor ad experiences that inflate acquisition costs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Calculate Ad Rank, CPC, and ROAS across 3 simulated bidding auction scenarios and map business manager user permissions.
lessons.expected_outcome: Paid Advertising Auction Economics & Account Governance Worksheet.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Search Campaign Architecture, RSAs & Match Types
lessons.what_is_taught: Structuring Google Search campaigns, ad groups, keyword match types, negative keyword hygiene, and responsive search ads.
subtopics: Campaign hierarchy: Account -> Campaign -> Ad Groups -> Keywords & Ads
Keyword Match Types: Broad Match, Phrase Match, and Exact Match mechanics in 2026
Negative Keyword Lists: Account-level, campaign-level, and ad-group-level negative keyword hygiene
Responsive Search Ads (RSA): Formulating 15 diverse headlines, 4 descriptions, and strategic pinning logic
Ad Assets (Extensions): Sitelinks, Callouts, Structured Snippets, Call Assets, and Lead Form assets
Search Term Report analysis: Mining high-converting search queries and pruning budget-wasting terms
lessons.why_it_matters: Properly grouped search campaigns with disciplined negative keyword lists achieve higher Quality Scores and significantly lower cost per click.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a complete Google Search campaign in draft mode with 2 tightly themed ad groups, match-typed keywords, 1 negative list, 1 full RSA, and 3 ad assets.
lessons.expected_outcome: Google Search Campaign Architecture Blueprint & Draft Ad Group Setup.

lessons.lesson_title: Bidding Fundamentals, Conversion Actions, AI Max & PMax
lessons.what_is_taught: Bidding strategy selection, daily budget pacing, Google conversion actions, and introductory AI Max and Performance Max (PMax).
subtopics: Bidding strategy selection: Manual CPC vs. Smart Bidding (Maximize Clicks, Maximize Conversions, Target CPA, Target ROAS)
Budget controls, daily pacing, delivery methods, and shared budget logic
Google Ads Conversion Actions: Primary vs. Secondary actions and conversion tracking linking
Introduction to Performance Max (PMax): Cross-network inventory, asset groups, audience signals, and required exclusions
Introduction to AI Max for Search: Dynamic headlines/descriptions, final URL expansion, and required brand exclusions
lessons.why_it_matters: Smart bidding algorithms require clean conversion data and strict guardrails to prevent automated systems from exhausting client budget.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configure conversion actions, set bidding targets for a sample ₹30,000 budget, and audit automated search asset settings.
lessons.expected_outcome: Bidding Strategy & Automated Campaign Guardrails Specification.

lessons.lesson_title: Meta Ads Manager Hierarchy, Objectives & Audience Targeting
lessons.what_is_taught: Navigating Meta Ads Manager, ODAX campaign objectives, ad set configuration, placement optimization, and audience definitions.
subtopics: Meta Ads Manager hierarchy: Campaign (Objective) -> Ad Set (Audience, Budget, Placement) -> Ad (Creative & Copy)
Campaign Objectives under ODAX: Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, App Promotion, Sales
Audience targeting taxonomy: Core Audiences (location, demographics, detailed interests), Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences
Placement optimization: Advantage+ Placements vs. Manual Placements (Feeds, Stories, Reels)
Budget allocation models: Advantage Campaign Budget (CBO) vs. Ad Set Budget Optimization (ABO)
lessons.why_it_matters: Structuring ad sets and selecting appropriate campaign objectives ensures Meta's machine learning algorithm finds high-converting users efficiently.
lessons.what_learner_does: Set up a Meta campaign in draft mode, configure 2 distinct ad sets targeting local interest clusters and demographic profiles with manual placement testing.
lessons.expected_outcome: Meta Campaign Hierarchy & Audience Targeting Setup Workbook.

lessons.lesson_title: Meta Lead Generation, Instant Forms, Advantage+ & Ad Policy
lessons.what_is_taught: Building native instant lead generation forms, creative formatting, Advantage+ automation features, and platform policy compliance.
subtopics: Building Native Instant Forms: Intro banner, qualifying custom questions, prefill data, privacy policy link, completion screen
Creative formats: Single image ads, multi-card carousels, and vertical video ads
Advantage+ Creative enhancements: Text variations, visual touches, and aspect-ratio adjustments
Retargeting fundamentals: Custom audiences built from web visitors and social page engagement
Platform Advertising Policies: Prohibited content, personal attributes, health/finance claims, and avoiding account suspensions
Zero-spend verification: Testing and reviewing campaign drafts without connecting payment methods
lessons.why_it_matters: Native instant forms capture high-volume mobile leads without landing page load friction; policy compliance prevents devastating account bans.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a native Meta Instant Form with custom qualifying questions, assemble 2 ad creative variants, and run an ad policy pre-flight check.
lessons.expected_outcome: Native Instant Lead Generation Form Build & Ad Policy Compliance Checklist.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build one Google Search campaign and one Meta lead-generation campaign using an authorized account, draft, or clearly labeled offline simulation.
modules.assignment: Student Deliverable 4: Google & Meta Advertising Campaign Project Evidence (comprehensive campaign build workbook, exported ad spreadsheets, draft preview screenshots, and compliance verification checklist).
modules.business_application: Core operational skill set required for Junior Paid Ads Executives, PPC Specialists, and Paid Social Media Buyers.
modules.expected_outcome: Verified dual-platform paid advertising build dossier complying with the Zero-Student-Ad-Spend Policy.

modules.module_purpose: Equip learners to design, edit, and optimize conversion-focused campaign landing pages, embed functional lead generation mechanisms, and test end-to-end customer conversion journeys.
what_you_will_learn: Understand the difference between general corporate websites and focused 1:1 campaign landing pages.
Construct and style responsive web pages in WordPress using core Gutenberg blocks.
Write benefit-driven conversion copy, establish CTA hierarchies, and integrate trust signals.
Embed functional lead generation forms with custom fields, thank-you pages, and lead magnets.
Implement UTM parameter campaign tracking and test end-to-end lead conversion flows.

lessons.lesson_title: Web Marketing Architecture & Landing Page Anatomy
lessons.what_is_taught: The strategic purpose of campaign landing pages, information architecture, mobile-first design principles, and conversion friction.
subtopics: Websites vs. Dedicated Campaign Landing Pages: The 1:1 attention ratio and elimination of navigation leaks
Anatomy of a high-converting landing page: Above-the-fold hero, value proposition, proof elements, benefit matrix, FAQ, footer CTA
Mobile-first responsive UX: Tap targets, sticky CTAs, readable typography, and page speed impacts on bounce rate
Psychological friction: Reducing visual clutter, cognitive overload, and anxiety in the conversion path
lessons.why_it_matters: Even high-performing paid ads will fail to generate revenue if the destination landing page confuses or frustrates mobile users.
lessons.what_learner_does: Wireframe a mobile-first campaign landing page layout, mapping content sections to user decision stages.
lessons.expected_outcome: Mobile-First Landing Page Wireframe & Information Architecture Plan.

lessons.lesson_title: WordPress Block Editing & Responsive Page Construction
lessons.what_is_taught: Navigating WordPress CMS, working with pages, themes, and plugins, and structuring landing pages with Gutenberg blocks.
subtopics: WordPress CMS core architecture: Pages vs. Posts, theme customizer, and plugin ecosystem
Building landing pages with WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg): Columns, Groups, Covers, Spacers, Buttons
Utilizing lightweight block libraries and responsive visual controls
Configuring responsive breakpoints (desktop, tablet, mobile viewports)
lessons.why_it_matters: Enables digital marketers to rapidly build, iterate, and publish campaign landing pages without depending on web developers.
lessons.what_learner_does: Assemble and style a complete responsive campaign landing page inside a sandbox WordPress or LocalWP environment.
lessons.expected_outcome: Structured WordPress Landing Page Draft with Responsive Layouts.

lessons.lesson_title: Conversion Copywriting, CTA Hierarchy & Trust Signals
lessons.what_is_taught: Formulating benefit-driven headlines, establishing primary and secondary call-to-action hierarchies, and integrating social proof.
subtopics: Crafting compelling hero headlines and benefit-oriented subheadings that answer 'What's in it for me?'
Call to Action (CTA) hierarchy: Primary vs. Secondary buttons, button microcopy, and color contrast
Trust and credibility architecture: Customer testimonials, review star ratings, partner badges, and security seals
Risk reversal strategies: Guarantees, free trials, transparent pricing, and privacy reassurances
lessons.why_it_matters: Compelling conversion copy and prominent trust signals build the confidence required for users to submit personal contact data.
lessons.what_learner_does: Write all landing page copy sections, including hero headline variants, benefit bullet points, testimonial blocks, and button microcopy.
lessons.expected_outcome: Landing Page Conversion Copy Deck with Trust Signal Blueprint.

lessons.lesson_title: Lead Capture Forms, Thank-You Funnels & Lead Magnets
lessons.what_is_taught: Designing lead generation forms, balancing form friction with lead quality, configuring thank-you redirect funnels, and lead delivery.
subtopics: Designing high-converting lead capture forms: Field count vs. conversion rate optimization
Installing and configuring WordPress form plugins (WPForms / Fluent Forms)
Building dedicated Thank-You Pages: Setting expectations, next steps, and secondary conversion actions
Lead magnet delivery mechanisms: Direct file download redirects vs. automated confirmation email links
lessons.why_it_matters: The lead form and thank-you funnel represent the critical conversion bridge between anonymous visitor and actionable sales lead.
lessons.what_learner_does: Create and embed a working multi-field lead capture form on WordPress, configure input validation, and connect a custom Thank-You redirect page.
lessons.expected_outcome: Functional Lead Capture Form & Automated Thank-You Page Funnel.

lessons.lesson_title: UTM Parameter Tracking, Basic CRO & Journey Testing
lessons.what_is_taught: Constructing standard UTM campaign URLs, testing form-to-lead handoffs, introductory conversion rate optimization, and behavioral analysis.
subtopics: UTM parameter taxonomy: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content`
Building tracking URLs using the Google Campaign URL Builder
Introduction to Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Diagnosing bounce rates and form abandonment
Introductory session observation with Microsoft Clarity (heatmaps, scroll depth, rage clicks)
End-to-end conversion journey testing: Form submission, email notification, redirect verification, and tracking parameter persistence
lessons.why_it_matters: Proper UTM tagging ensures accurate channel attribution in analytics, while journey testing guarantees no leads are lost to technical bugs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Generate 3 tagged campaign URLs, submit live test leads through the landing page, and audit notification delivery and redirect flow.
lessons.expected_outcome: UTM Tracking Sheet & Conversion Flow Verification Checklist.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a campaign landing page with working forms and a testable lead conversion flow.
modules.assignment: Student Deliverable 2: Fully Functional, Optimized Campaign Landing Page (live staging URL or LocalWP export, with working lead form, thank-you page flow, and UTM tracking documentation).
modules.business_application: Crucial for inbound campaign execution, performance marketing coordination, and lead generation management.
modules.expected_outcome: Live, testable WordPress landing page ready to receive paid or organic marketing traffic.

modules.module_purpose: Provide practical, hands-on mastery over Google Analytics 4 (GA4), web conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager (GTM), data hygiene, and automated executive reporting in Looker Studio.
what_you_will_learn: Navigate GA4 properties, configure web data streams, and analyze Traffic Acquisition reports.
Understand the event-based data model, default events, and mark high-value events as Key Events.
Deploy Google Tag Manager (GTM) containers and configure custom click and form triggers.
Implement and test custom GA4 Event Tags in GTM Tag Assistant Preview mode on sandbox sites.
Calculate core marketing math formulas: CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, and ROAS.
Build interactive single-page marketing dashboards connecting GA4 and Search Console in Looker Studio.

lessons.lesson_title: GA4 Architecture, Data Streams & Traffic Acquisition Reports
lessons.what_is_taught: The event-based measurement model of GA4, account and property hierarchy, web data streams, Enhanced Measurement, and acquisition reporting.
subtopics: Evolution from Universal Analytics session-based model to GA4 event-driven data model
Account structure: Accounts, GA4 Properties, and Web/App Data Streams
Enhanced Measurement: Automated capture of pageviews, 90% scrolls, outbound clicks, file downloads
Navigating Standard Reports: Acquisition, Engagement, Monetization, and Retention
Traffic Acquisition reporting: Default Channel Groups, Source / Medium, and campaign attribution basics
lessons.why_it_matters: GA4 is the global enterprise standard for web measurement; understanding its data model is essential for accurate marketing attribution.
lessons.what_learner_does: Navigate a GA4 property, inspect data stream settings, analyze traffic acquisition by source/medium, and compare session vs. user metrics.
lessons.expected_outcome: GA4 Traffic Acquisition Analysis & Data Stream Audit Report.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Tag Manager (GTM) Setup, Triggers & Event Tags
lessons.what_is_taught: The purpose of GTM, container architecture, tags, triggers, variables, and deploying custom GA4 event tags.
subtopics: Why use GTM: Decoupling marketing measurement tags from website source code
GTM Hierarchy: Accounts, Containers, Tags, Triggers, and Variables
Built-in Variables (Click URL, Click Classes, Page Path) and custom trigger types (All Clicks, Form Submission)
Deploying the Google Tag on a WordPress website via GTM
Creating custom GA4 Event Tags (e.g., `button_click`, `form_submit`, `generate_lead`)
Using GTM Preview & Debug Mode (Tag Assistant) to inspect tag firing status and trigger conditions
lessons.why_it_matters: GTM empowers marketers to instrument tracking events across websites without writing code or risking site downtime.
lessons.what_learner_does: Install GTM on a sandbox site, configure 3 custom event tags (phone click, CTA button click, form submit), and debug firing in Tag Assistant.
lessons.expected_outcome: Configured GTM Container Export (.json) & Tag Assistant Debug Log.

lessons.lesson_title: Key Events, Conversion Linking & Measurement Hygiene
lessons.what_is_taught: Marking GA4 Key Events (formerly conversions), linking Google Ads and Search Console, and measurement quality standards.
subtopics: The 'Key Events' terminology in GA4: Designating high-value user actions as Key Events
Linking GA4 with Google Ads and Google Search Console accounts
Importing GA4 Key Events into Google Ads for Smart Bidding optimization
Measurement hygiene: Internal traffic filtering (excluding agency/employee IP addresses)
Consent Mode v2 overview and privacy-compliant tracking fundamentals
Important operational rule: Google's public demo account is read-only; tagging must occur on student sandbox sites
lessons.why_it_matters: Clean, properly designated conversion data is mandatory for algorithmic ad bidding and reliable client reporting.
lessons.what_learner_does: Mark verified form submission events as Key Events in GA4, review account link settings, and configure internal IP filters.
lessons.expected_outcome: GA4 Key Event Configuration & Measurement Hygiene Plan.

lessons.lesson_title: Core Marketing Math, Commercial Metrics & ROAS Calculations
lessons.what_is_taught: Computational formulas, financial meaning, and diagnostic benchmarks for core commercial marketing metrics.
subtopics: CTR (Click-Through Rate) calculation: (Clicks / Impressions) x 100
CPC (Cost Per Click): Total Ad Spend / Total Clicks
CPL (Cost Per Lead) & CPA (Cost Per Acquisition): Total Cost / Total Conversions
ROAS (Return on Ad Spend): (Total Revenue Generated from Ads / Total Ad Spend) x 100%
Break-Even ROAS, Profit Margin analysis, and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) vs. Lifetime Value (LTV)
lessons.why_it_matters: Marketing executives are judged on business revenue and acquisition profitability, not vanity engagement impressions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Solve a multi-channel performance calculation problem set, computing CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, and ROAS across 3 sample client scenarios.
lessons.expected_outcome: Marketing Performance Mathematics & ROAS Calculation Workbook.

lessons.lesson_title: Looker Studio Dashboard Construction & Executive Reporting
lessons.what_is_taught: Connecting Looker Studio to data sources, designing executive dashboards, selecting visual chart types, and writing summary insights.
subtopics: Connecting Looker Studio to GA4 and Google Search Console data connectors
Dashboard layout principles: Scorecards, time-series traffic charts, channel acquisition tables, and device donut charts
Adding interactive date range controls and channel filter dropdowns
Data formatting, conditional formatting heatmaps, and brand styling
Drafting executive summary commentary: Translating data charts into actionable business recommendations
lessons.why_it_matters: Clients and corporate stakeholders expect clear, automated, visual dashboards rather than complex raw analytics tables.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build an interactive, single-page marketing dashboard in Looker Studio connecting live/sample GA4 data, complete with scorecards, charts, and date filters.
lessons.expected_outcome: Live Shareable Looker Studio Marketing Performance Dashboard.

modules.expected_outcome: Live interactive analytics dashboard and verified web tracking container ready for commercial deployment.

modules.module_purpose: Teach ethical, permission-based email marketing, audience segmentation, conversion-driven copywriting, and automated welcome/nurturing sequences using modern ESP software.
what_you_will_learn: Understand permission-based email marketing, deliverability fundamentals, and compliance laws (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, DPDP).
Manage contact lists, handle unsubscribes, and segment audiences based on engagement and demographics.
Write high-converting email copy, craft compelling subject lines, and design responsive email templates.
Build a 3-part automated welcome and lead nurturing email sequence with delay timers in Brevo.

lessons.lesson_title: Email Marketing Foundations, Deliverability & Compliance
lessons.what_is_taught: The strategic power of owned audiences, global email compliance regulations, deliverability factors, and spam filter avoidance.
subtopics: Owned marketing channels vs. rented platform algorithms: Long-term asset value
Global email regulations: Consent mechanisms, opt-in rules, physical address requirements, and easy unsubscribes (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, DPDP)
Email deliverability fundamentals: Sender reputation, domain authentication overview (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and bounce rates
Spam trigger words, sender name consistency, and inbox placement best practices
lessons.why_it_matters: Non-compliant email marketing triggers heavy legal penalties, burned domain reputations, and zero inbox placement.
lessons.what_learner_does: Audit an email newsletter for compliance factors, check domain authentication concepts, and run a spam trigger pre-flight check.
lessons.expected_outcome: Email Compliance & Deliverability Pre-Flight Checklist.

subtopics: Contact list hygiene: Opt-in confirmation, handling hard vs. soft bounces, and managing unsubscriptions
Audience segmentation: Demographic, purchase history, website engagement, and open/click recency
Lead capture integration: Routing leads from WordPress form submissions into email lists via native integrations or webhooks
Custom contact attributes: Mapping name, email, phone, location, and interest tags
lessons.why_it_matters: Segmented email campaigns achieve dramatically higher open rates, lower unsubscribe rates, and superior conversion ROI than generic blast emails.
lessons.what_learner_does: Set up a subscriber list in Brevo with custom contact attributes, configure tags, and test lead ingestion from a web form.
lessons.expected_outcome: Brevo Subscriber List Architecture & Ingestion Setup.

lessons.lesson_title: Email Copywriting, Design & Subject Line A/B Testing
lessons.what_is_taught: Anatomy of high-converting emails, direct-response email copywriting, responsive visual template building, and subject line optimization.
subtopics: Anatomy of a marketing email: Sender name, subject line, preheader text, visual hero, body copy, and primary CTA
Email copywriting frameworks: The Soap Opera Sequence, educational storytelling, and urgency/scarcity ethics
Designing responsive, accessible email templates using Brevo's drag-and-drop builder
Subject line psychology, curiosity triggers, preview text pairing, and A/B split testing
lessons.why_it_matters: The subject line determines whether the email is opened; the body copy and CTA determine whether the lead takes commercial action.
lessons.what_learner_does: Draft copy for a 3-part email sequence and design a responsive branded email template inside Brevo.
lessons.expected_outcome: Branded Email Template Design & Multi-Email Copy Deck.

lessons.lesson_title: Brevo Configuration & 3-Part Automated Welcome Sequence
lessons.what_is_taught: Setting up visual marketing automations in Brevo, defining entry triggers, delay timers, and crafting an effective welcome nurturing sequence.

Setting up the 3-part Lead Nurturing / Welcome Sequence:

• Email 2: Brand Story, Problem Agitation & Educational Value (sent Day +2)

modules.business_application: Demonstrates holistic job-readiness for Digital Marketing Executive, Junior SEO Executive, Social Media Executive, and Junior Paid Ads roles.
modules.expected_outcome: Comprehensive professional graduate portfolio case study and accredited Certified AI Digital Marketing Specialist credential.

core_projects.project_brief: Conduct a comprehensive organic search audit for a realistic local business. Research high-intent search queries, group them into intent clusters, map them to target web URLs, and formulate a local Google Business Profile optimization plan with LocalBusiness schema.
expected_deliverables: 15+ keyword intent map with search volumes, KD, and URL mapping
5-page on-page SEO optimization plan (title, meta, H1-H3, internal links)
Technical crawlability and indexing checklist
Google Business Profile audit and NAP consistency action plan
evaluation_criteria: Alignment of keyword intent with target URL commercial purpose
Correct metadata syntax within recommended character limits
Absence of keyword cannibalization across mapped URLs
Adherence to Google Search Essentials and absence of unscientific ranking promises
core_projects.evidence_required_for_assessment: Multi-tab spreadsheet containing keyword clusters, on-page optimization templates, GSC diagnostic findings, and generated LocalBusiness JSON-LD code.

core_projects.project_brief: Develop an organic social media marketing campaign for a consumer-facing brand. Define content pillars, construct a 14-day editorial schedule, design 8 production-grade visual creatives in Canva, and write/produce 4 short-form video concepts.
expected_deliverables: 14-day multi-channel editorial content calendar
8 Canva creatives (including 2 carousels and 2 vertical Stories/Reels assets)
Direct-response copy deck with tested hooks and CTAs (AIDA/PAS)
4 short-form video storyboards and 1 fully edited mobile reel
evaluation_criteria: Visual hierarchy, typography pairing, and brand kit consistency
Hook engagement strength (first 3-second attention capture)
Clear call-to-action alignment with content pillar objectives
Responsible and commercially compliant generative AI usage
core_projects.evidence_required_for_assessment: Editorial calendar spreadsheet, Canva design portfolio links/exports, video script documents, and exported MP4 reel.

core_projects.project_brief: Build a multi-channel paid acquisition system in draft mode without ad spend. Structure a high-intent Google Search campaign with RSAs and negative keyword lists, paired with a Meta lead generation campaign featuring native Instant Forms.
expected_deliverables: Google Search campaign hierarchy: 2 ad groups, exact/phrase match keywords, negative lists
Responsive Search Ad copy matrix: 10+ headlines, 4 descriptions, 3 ad assets
Meta lead campaign structure: 2 ad set audience targetings and placement rules
Native Meta Instant Form with custom qualifying questions and privacy policy link
evaluation_criteria: Relevance between keywords, ad headlines, and search intent
Negative keyword hygiene preventing budget wastage
Compliance with Google and Meta advertising policies
Adherence to the Zero-Student-Ad-Spend Policy
core_projects.evidence_required_for_assessment: Google Ads Editor export or comprehensive campaign build spreadsheet, draft preview screenshots, and ad policy verification checklist.

core_projects.project_brief: Design and publish a conversion-focused campaign landing page on a WordPress sandbox site. Embed a functional lead capture form, configure thank-you redirects, append UTM tracking parameters, deploy Google Tag Manager, and verify GA4 event firing.
expected_deliverables: Live responsive WordPress campaign landing page URL
Functional multi-field lead capture form and thank-you redirect flow
Configured GTM container with 3 custom event tags (click, CTA, form submission)
GA4 Key Event designation and Tag Assistant verification logs
UTM campaign tracking URL documentation
evaluation_criteria: Mobile UX responsiveness, readability, and tap target sizing
Conversion copy clarity, CTA hierarchy, and trust signal integration
Accurate GTM trigger conditions and verified tag firing in Tag Assistant
Error-free form validation and lead notification routing
core_projects.evidence_required_for_assessment: Live landing page link (or LocalWP export), GTM container JSON export file, Tag Assistant debug screenshots, and GA4 DebugView confirmation logs.

core_projects.project_title: Integrated Local Business Digital Marketing Capstone
core_projects.project_brief: Synthesize all course disciplines into a complete, integrated digital marketing acquisition campaign for a realistic local business. Produce all cross-channel assets, model a monthly budget, analyze 30 days of simulated performance data, compile an optimization plan, and defend decisions in an oral viva.
expected_deliverables: Integrated Strategy Document: Audience ICP, positioning, and ₹50,000 budget allocation
Cross-channel asset suite: SEO map, social creatives, ad builds, landing page, and email welcome sequence
Single-page Looker Studio executive reporting dashboard connected to GA4 and GSC
30-day simulated performance analysis and iterative optimization roadmap
Completed practical troubleshooting examination and oral viva voce defense
evaluation_criteria: Internal consistency across funnel stages, channel messaging, and conversion paths
Accuracy of marketing math formulas (CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, break-even)
Professional dashboard visualization standards and executive commentary quality
Technical problem-solving competence during the live troubleshooting examination
Clarity, professionalism, and strategic defense during the oral viva voce
core_projects.evidence_required_for_assessment: Complete Master Portfolio Deck (PDF/Notion), interactive Looker Studio shareable link, practical troubleshooting test log, and faculty viva evaluation rubric.

breakdown.desc: Evaluation of SEO audit, social media creative campaign, Google/Meta ad builds, WordPress landing page, and GA4 Looker Studio dashboard.
End-to-end local business marketing plan and multi-channel asset synthesis executed under simulated agency conditions.
Hands-on timed laboratory test diagnosing broken tracking tags, ad policy rejections, and search indexing errors.
15-minute presentation defending channel selection, budget allocation, attribution methodology, and AI ethical boundaries.
